content.title: Weltkugel
content.body:
Test-Rasterbild. Steht mittig und wackelt nur leicht (bob).
Weitere Objekte einfach als neue Entities mit eigenem Bild ergänzen.

entities._kommentar: SCENE 2 (die station). 'variants'=Ordner mit Bild-Varianten. Bewegungs-Felder (Locomotion-Recherche): swim ('pulse'=Qualle, 'jet'=Kalmar), ease (Ebben/Hovern), weave (seitl. Pendeln), jitter (Station-Keeping), faceForward/facing (Sprite zeigt nach vorn). TIEFE/3D: 'layer' (0..<1, hoeher=weiter vorn; Station=1 immer ganz vorn) + Groesse (scale) + Deckkraft (opacity) gestaffelt -> atmosphaerische Perspektive (fern=klein/blass, nah=gross/kraeftig). Krill+Fischschwaerme sind PROZEDURAL (drawScene2Fauna).

STATION-INFO-HOTSPOTS (Szene 2). Der 'The station'-Marker oeffnet KEINE Unterszene mehr, sondern blendet diese Hotspots direkt auf dem sichtbaren Bimsstein ein (stationInfo:true -> nur bei aktivem Marker; stOff = Offset in Stein-Radien, sitzt live am Stein). Klick -> Callout-Etikett wie bei den Section-Hotspots.
entities.label: Floating stone

content.title: Floating stone
content.body: The station is not a ship and is anchored to nothing, but a drifting block of pumice — light, porous volcanic rock that floats. In this world, constant volcanic activity on the drowned seafloor erupts pumice in enormous quantities; these giant rafts of stone rise to the surface, and people hollow them out and live within the stone itself, in the bubbles and cavities it already holds.

content.title: Below the surface
content.body: Because the sun is now lethal, the water is shelter, so people live beneath the surface where the water shields them. Only the station's highest point breaks into the open air, the Solar Space, the single room that receives natural light, while everything else is layered downward into the shielded dark.

content.title: Living light
content.body: Apart from the Solar Space there is no daylight inside at all, so every passage and chamber is lit by living light: cultivated fluorescent bacteria, glowing fungi, and bioluminescent plants grown along the walls like a tended crop, joined by the light of the Sea Devils that gather around the station.

content.title: Weighted keel
content.body: Because raw floating stone would roll in the swell, the station is trimmed like a keel, with heavy ballast tanks in the lower modules pulling the centre of gravity deep below the waterline while the upper third is kept deliberately light. It floats like a buoy, pushed by the swell but always returning upright, holding its light-bearing crown to the surface.

content.title: Found and grown
content.body: The people work the pumice like found rock, settling into its natural hollows and opening new ones only where it allows, and only where a surface must be sealed or a form shaped do they grow a hard mineral crust (Biorock). Even that obeys only in part, since the sea adds its own turns, so the architecture is co-authored by the ocean.

content.title: Breathing drift
content.body: The station drifts slowly across the ocean, steered patiently by warming the water around it with focused sunlight, and as currents move through its mineral hull it groans without pause — a sound the inhabitants call the breathing of the world — while inside, people navigate the dark by the songs that belong to each place.

entities._kommentar: WILDLIFE-INFO-HOTSPOTS (Szene 2). Der 'Wildlife'-Marker oeffnet KEINE Unterszene mehr, sondern blendet diese Hotspots direkt in Szene 2 ein (wildlifeInfo:true -> nur bei aktivem Marker; feste Bildposition ueber path). Klick -> Callout-Etikett wie bei den Station-Info-Hotspots.
entities.label: The deep rose up

content.title: The deep rose up
content.body: The collapse left only a few survivors, but for them the drowned world is near-perfect: populations have swelled and most animals now grow to at least twice the size of their ancestors. In the old world the sunlit shallows teemed and the deep lay near-empty — now the light kills from above, so the order has inverted, and deep-water and open-ocean creatures spread up into the shaded middle depths. Krill anchors the whole food web, and the whales now outweigh what is left of humanity, their songs carrying through every depth and every hull. Terrestrial life has all but vanished.

content.title: Bound to the station
content.body: Where once the sea kept its distance from people, life now gathers around them. Drawn by warmth and the small life the human presence feeds, fish, sponges, jellyfish and glowing hunters colonise the drifting stone like a reef — the Sea Devils among them, whose steady glow the people have made their light. Each station carries its own gathered ecosystem as it drifts, a knot of life in an empty sea.

entities._kommentar: Tiefsee-Seadevil: gross, tief lauernd; Tiefen-Verdunkelung macht ihn schemenhaft.

SCENE 3 (das eye). Heller Kuppel-Innenraum (drawSolarSpace). Bild-Sprites wie Scene 2: 'variants'=Ordner. Phase 3 = nur Bild, daher alle interactive:false (kein Klick/Panel). Figuren sitzen am Beckenrand (y~0.74-0.80, Wasserkante bei y-von-unten 0.20), fast still (kleines bob). Tuecher (cloth) treiben langsam auf. Fehlen Bilder -> prozeduraler Platzhalter.
Optional: treibendes Tuch/Token der Mond-Gabe, langsam aufsteigend.

SECTION (der Schnitt). Klickbare Hotspots ('hotspot:true' -> pulsierender Gold-Ring statt Bild). interactive:true -> bestehende Klick->Panel-Mechanik. Position = einzelner Pfadpunkt (normiert). Texte englisch. Der 'sea_level'-Hotspot hat zusaetzlich action:'seaLevelRise' -> loest beim Oeffnen den Wasseranstieg aus.
entities.label: Magnetic field

content.title: Magnetic field — weakened
content.body: The planet no longer deflects the sun's outbursts. Solar storms bring sudden, lethal radiation spikes — without warning.

content.title: Ozone layer — torn
content.body: CO₂, methane and fossil fires tore the ozone layer open. UV and cosmic radiation reach the surface almost unfiltered.

content.title: Photochemical smog — never lifted
content.body: A permanent photochemical haze hangs over the water — toxic, self-renewing. It tints the light a warm, filtered gold.

content.title: Sea level — risen
content.body: The old coast lies far below. As the ice went and the water warmed, the sea climbed to today's level — swallowing the land where life once held on.

content.title: The surface is lethal
content.body: Unprotected, a lethal dose in hours. The most stable water lies in a band just below the surface — warm from above, deep enough against the radiation.

content.title: The cold deep
content.body: Below the warm band the water turns cold and dark. Only a faint bioluminescent green still moves down there.

entities._kommentar: VIZ-HOTSPOTS. Wie die Section-Hotspots (hotspot:true -> pulsierender Gold-Ring, Klick -> Callout-Etikett). Die path-Koords sind PLATZHALTER: die Position wird zur Laufzeit von vizHotspotNorm() auf das gezeichnete Feature gesetzt (id-basiert). Texte englisch. SUN (scene 'sun', aus Szene 1).
entities.label: The lethal source

content.title: The lethal source
content.body: No one sees her directly. Filtered to a faint gold, her raw light kills at the surface within hours — why is the sky's story.

content.title: The engine
content.body: Uneven heat sets the whole water column turning — the currents that never rest. The people call it the breathing of the world.

content.title: Solar storms
content.body: Now and then the field snaps and hurls a burst of plasma outward. With no magnetic shield left below, these arrive at the surface as sudden, lethal spikes.

entities._kommentar: STATION (scene 'station_cut', aus Szene 2). Querschnitt der Unterwasser-Station: Material, Funktion.
entities.label: Pressure hull

content.title: Pressure hull — material
content.body: A double steel-and-composite shell holds back the weight of the water above. Rounded and seamless, it is built to be pressed on from every side and hold.

content.title: Life support
content.body: Sealed loops scrub the air and recycle every drop of water. Nothing is vented that can be kept — the station breathes on itself.

content.title: Ballast & buoyancy
content.body: Flooded and blown tanks trim the station's depth, holding it in the safe band — never surfacing into the radiation, never sinking to the cold.

content.title: Airlock
content.body: The only way in or out. Divers cycle through slowly, matching pressure, before the short, shielded swim in the water outside.

entities._kommentar: LIVING (scene 'habitat', aus Szene 2). Leben im Stein: Wohnen · Bewegung/Immunitaet · Navigation/Licht. Erzaehlt als Ich-Zeugnis eines Stationsbewohners (Quote) + Kernfakten-Gloss.
entities.label: Dwelling

content.title: Dwelling in the stone
content.body: “We do not build the rooms. We find them. The stone is full of hollows, and we widen what it lets us. My shelf, my bed, they grow out of the wall. Nothing here stands on the floor. Everything is tied down, or it belongs to the sea.” Rooms are found in the pumice's natural cavities and only widened where the stone allows; furniture is grown straight from the wall. Because the station is forever rocking, nothing rests loose — it is lashed down or lost. A quiet praise of shadows.

content.title: The sway
content.body: “The station never holds still. It breathes, it rolls, and we roll with it. We filled the deep rooms with the heaviest things we could spare, so it sways soft and low. The sea makes us sick no more. I feel a wrong motion before any gauge does.” The constant, gentle motion is what people call the breathing of the world. Ballast packed into the deep rooms drops the centre of gravity so the roll stays slow and shallow. Born to it, the inhabitants are immune to seasickness and read the tilt as a sense of their own — a body that feels a fault before any instrument shows it.

content.title: Finding the way
content.body: “In the dark I find my way by four things at once. The song that belongs to this place. The stone under my hand. The markers where the passage turns. And the lean of the floor, which tells me where the light is. The light itself we grow, on the walls.” Navigation runs on four senses together — the song that marks a place (never a rank), the touch of the stone, the markers at the turns, and the lean of the floor. There are no light-shafts in the dwellings; the light is grown, a crop of fluorescent biomass on the walls, joined by the glow of the Sea Devils.
